creation_gate.description: Creation gate while no pre-propose module is installed. Default `ProposerGate {}` (legacy).

dao.description:
DAO DAO core address. Default: the instantiator (a DAO core instantiates its proposal modules,
exactly like dao-proposal-single, which uses `info.sender`).

min_submit_stake.description: Required: minimum bonded stake (bond denom) of the assignee to submit work; "0" disables. No default.

min_upload_stake.description:
Required: minimum bonded stake (bond denom) to upload documents through the CID storage service
(checked off chain via `can_upload`); "0" disables. No default.

params_placeholder.description: Required: true while the values are unvoted placeholders.

params_version.description: Required label of this parameter set; no default.

pre_propose_info.description:
dao-voting pre-propose config. Default `AnyoneMayPropose {}` (then `creation_gate` applies).
`ModuleMayPropose { info }` instantiates the module (admin = dao) and gives it exclusive
creation rights once its instantiate reply arrives (fails open to Anyone until then, as upstream).

definitions.name: cosmwasm_std_math_uint256_Uint256

anyone_may_propose.description: Anyone may create a proposal free of charge.

module_may_propose.description:
The module specified in INFO has exclusive rights to proposal
creation.

definitions.name: dao_interface_state_ModuleInstantiateInfo
definitions.description: Information needed to instantiate a module.

admin.description:
CosmWasm level admin of the instantiated contract. See:
<https://docs.cosmwasm.com/docs/1.0/smart-contracts/migration>

code_id.description: Code ID of the contract to be instantiated.

funds.description: Funds to be sent to the instantiated contract.

msg.description: Instantiate message to be used to create the contract.

salt.description:
Salt to use with instantiate2, if defined. Otherwise uses normal
instantiate.

definitions.name: cosmwasm_std_binary_Binary
definitions.description:
Binary is a wrapper around Vec<u8> to add base64 de/serialization
with serde. It also adds some helper methods to help encode inline.

This is only needed as serde-json-{core,wasm} has a horrible encoding for Vec<u8>.
See also <https://github.com/CosmWasm/cosmwasm/blob/main/docs/MESSAGE_TYPES.md>.

definitions.name: dao_interface_state_Admin
definitions.description:
Information about the CosmWasm level admin of a contract. Used in
conjunction with `ModuleInstantiateInfo` to instantiate modules.

address.description: Set the admin to a specified address.

core_module.description: Sets the admin as the core module address.

definitions.name: terp_bounty_escrow_state_CreationGate
definitions.description:
Who may create a bounty while the creation policy is `Anyone {}` (no pre-propose module).
When a pre-propose module is installed (`ProposalCreationPolicy::Module`), that module is the gate
and this setting is not consulted.

anyone.description: (a) Anyone may deposit and create a bounty. Listing still needs the approver.

counterparty_escrow_proof.description:
(c) TODO, NOT IMPLEMENTED: a sound, private proof that the proposer deposited into an escrow on a
counterparty chain (e.g. Zcash shielded) without revealing the deposit details. See DESIGN.md §9.
Instantiate/update_config reject it and create would fail with `Unimplemented`.

min_stake.description:
(b) The sender's bonded stake in the chain bond denom (same `bonded()` check as
`ProposerGate.min_stake` and the submit/upload gates) must be >= `amount`. `amount` > 0.

proposer_gate.description: Legacy behaviour: the `ProposerGate` (allowlist / min_stake / cw4, any passes).
